records.mistake_description: Missed a hydrant item that the drawing shows
records.root_cause: CONFIRMED (adjudication): the composite NEW HYDRANT / EXISTING HYDRANTS TO BE REMOVED note was filed as a general-note mention and the existing hydrant was not counted. DEVELOPER HYPOTHESIS (not Checker-confirmed): it sat under a NOTES heading with its leader on a non-first line, there was no per-leader ownership, and the circle-with-rays symbol was not recognised
known_limitations: Removal is only counted when a call-out leader reaches the symbol; uncalled-out existing symbols are not counted (Edward St FH: documented, excluded from scoring).
Symbol test is vector-only (7-13 pt unfilled circle + >=3 short diagonal rays); raster or differently drawn legends fall to tag/unresolved.
